title: Sansula 04 F' [RAW]
author: cabled_mess
changes: Real recording of a single note plucked on a sansula (a kalimba thumb piano mounted on a small frame drum), used for the glowing mushroom for a gentle, magical sound. Trimmed to 0.00–2.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the low hum in the ring is the sansula's own drum resonance, not rumble.
